methodology: Native legal Lv150 reborn profiles, approved final-tier non-GM defensive equipment, actual game tick and natural dragon reflection. Ordinary attacks and offensive auto-cast are paused until a matching native window. During that window the native equipment and transformation-scroll paths prepare the selected card, then one real ordinary attack/paid tornado is attempted. Existing HP is never replenished, damage is never suppressed, and no wall/shield/immune effect is inserted. Aura remains active after transformation; first-hit opportunities remain permanent.
